title: SobraCero
appDescription: Rescue surplus food, find discounted lots, and help reduce food waste.
subtitle: Good food deserves another chance.
heroDescription: SobraCero connects restaurants and shops with people looking for discounted food lots that are close to their best-before date.
howItWorksTitle: A simple way to make more of food
businessListsDescription: Restaurants and shops list available lots with their price, quantity, and expiration date.
chooseAndReserveDescription: Browse the marketplace, check the discount, and reserve the amount you need.
foodGetsRescuedDescription: The business reduces surplus while you get good food at a better price.
availabilityDescription: Lots are listed by local businesses and may sell out.
noShops: No shops yet. Create one to start publishing lots.
noProducts: No products in this shop yet.
lotNoProducts: Create a product for this shop first.
detailBusinessCannotReserve: Business accounts cannot reserve lots. Use a customer account to place a reservation.
detailExpiryDisclaimer: AI can misread packaging. Review every suggested date before confirming it.
detailExpiryNeedsImage: Upload a lot photo before scanning.
detailExpiryActionError: Could not complete this expiry-date action. Try again.
detailExpiryConfirmed: The lot expiry date was updated.
dashboardDescription: Track product risk and turn surplus into opportunity.
dashboardRiskDescription: An estimate based on recent sales, weekdays, and expiration.
dashboardNoLots: There are no active lots to analyze for this business.
dashboardNoHistory: There is not enough sales history to calculate risk yet.
dashboardSampleNotice: Sample data is synthetic and intended only for testing forecasts.
dashboardSampleLoaded: Sample sales history loaded. Refreshing forecasts...
dashboardSampleDataError: Could not load sample sales history.
dashboardRecommendationDisclaimer: AI guidance is qualitative; risk scores and quantities are calculated by the app.
dashboardCreateWorkspaceDescription: Create a business and product to list surplus and see predictions.
dashboardSampleAction: Try a forecast with sample data
dashboardNoProducts: Add a product to start publishing food lots.
pickupDescription: Enter the reservation reference and pickup code provided by the customer.
pickupSuccess: Pickup confirmed. The customer reservation is complete.
pickupError: Could not confirm this pickup. Check the reference and code, then try again.
reservationAlreadyExists: You already reserved this lot. Use the pickup code you received.
reservationUnavailable: This lot could not be reserved. It may have sold out; refresh and try again.
marketDescription: Browse available food lots and reserve your favorites before they are gone.
marketEmptyDescription: Check back soon; businesses add new lots throughout the day.
rescueDescription: See what is likely to be left over before pickup closes, why, and decide what to do. Nothing changes until you approve.
rescueEmpty: No plans yet. Analyze a lot to get a recommendation.
rescueBarLabel: Expected sales {expected} units, estimated surplus {surplus} units
rescueMeta: {points} days of history · {hours} h horizon · rule {version}
rescueReason_stock_exceeds_expected_sale: Stock is higher than the sales expected before the pickup deadline.
rescueReason_surplus_above_donation_thre: The estimated surplus is large enough to prepare a donation offer.
rescueReason_surplus_above_discount_thre: The estimated surplus justifies a small discount step.
rescueReason_stock_covered_by_expected_s: Expected sales should cover the current stock.
rescueReason_discount_already_at_limit: The lot already has the maximum discount allowed by the rule.
rescueReason_pickup_window_short: The pickup window is short, which limits expected sales.
rescueReason_insufficient_history: There is not enough sales history to estimate numbers.
rescueError_rescue_plan_stale: The lot stock changed after this plan was created. Analyze the lot again.
rescueError_rescue_plan_conflict: Another change was applied at the same time. Try again.
rescueError_analysis_failed: The analysis service rejected the request. Try again later.
rescueDisclaimer: This is a heuristic estimate of unsold stock from past sales, not a trained price-response model. It does not certify food safety.
rescueError_ai_provider_unavailable: The AI service is unavailable right now. The numbers and reasons above still apply.
rescueError_ai_response_invalid: The AI could not produce a valid explanation. Try again.
rescueError_ai_quota_exceeded: You reached today's AI request allowance.
rescueGuideSignal: It compares the stock of a lot with the sales expected before pickup closes.
rescueGuideReasons: It explains its suggestion with clear reasons, never with a hidden score.
rescueGuideApproval: Nothing changes until the shop owner approves, and every decision is recorded.
